parts.name: Back of House
parts.description: All internal areas accessible by staff only, normally restricted to guests: staff offices, lobbies, amenities, circulation. Excludes Internal Service Areas (ISA).

parts.name: Front of House
parts.description: All internal areas accessible to guests: public realm, guest facilities, amenities. Includes internal public realm and guest circulation.

parts.name: Internal Service Area
parts.description: Areas for complex-use support: MEP spaces, storage provisions, mechanical rooms. Part of GFA but typically bundled separately.

parts.name: External Service Area
parts.description: Areas for complex-use support that are open-to-air: loading docks, rooftop plant, equipment areas.

parts.name: Structured Car Parking Area
parts.description: Standalone or integrated parking structure: parking bays, service areas, driveways.

parts.name: Retail / F&B
parts.description: Leasable retail and food & beverage tenant spaces.

parts.name: Cinema / Entertainment
parts.description: Leasable cinema or entertainment venue spaces.

parts.name: Atrium / Internal Covered Public Realm
parts.description: Internal public realm spaces, including covered atriums, circulation, and guest flow areas. Part of FOH.

parts.name: Void / Shaft
parts.description: Unenclosed vertical or horizontal voids (shafts, lift wells, vents). Measurement depends on whether it serves single tenant (interior-face) or multiple (centerline).
parts.note: Void boundaries are calculated but not summed into area totals. Flagged separately for void analysis.

parts.name: On-Site External Area
parts.description: Area surrounding Building Footprint, within Plot Area boundary: public realm, landscaping, guest roads, on-grade parking, service roads, loading areas.

parts.name: Off-Site External Area
parts.description: Area between Plot Area boundary and Project Area boundary: public realm, landscaping, road enhancements, on-grade parking, site conservation.
